2026-11-22.name: Sunday
2026-11-22.banner: Little River Road - October 2025 - Sarah Stierch.jpg
2026-11-22.lede: Five and a quarter hours of driving, an hour lost to the clock, three stops, and a park road at the end instead of the Parkway. Leave at seven and you are in the cabin with groceries by four.
route: Into the park at the Townsend Wye

planB.title: Plan B: Wears Valley instead of the park road
planB.when: Anyone carsick, Little River Road closed, or you are running late and want four lanes as long as possible.

slots.why: Same as Plan A through Maryville to Townsend.
Do not turn into the park. US-321 becomes Wears Valley Road and climbs over the ridge. Gentler curves, four miles shorter, and cell signal the whole way.
Right where Wears Valley Road meets Pigeon Forge. Do the full stock-up here instead of Food City.
slots.dest: Kroger, 220 Wears Valley Rd, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

slots.why: Traffic light #3 in Pigeon Forge. On a holiday Sunday budget 45 minutes for the next 12 miles. Take the Gatlinburg Bypass off the Spur to skip downtown entirely.
Same stall as Plan A. Playground, creek, bathrooms.

bail.name: Pilot Travel Center, exit 81
bail.why: If the car or a kid falls apart between Chattanooga and Townsend, this is the big clean stop with a real restroom block and hot food. Everything after it is two-lane.
bail.dest: Pilot Travel Center, Lenoir City, TN

kids: Cash gets the window and the job of calling out the state line and the time change.
Slavik rides in pajamas until Fort Payne. Potty in the car, not at the stop.
Snejana sleeps the first leg. The Athens stop is her real feed; do not rush it.

2026-11-23.name: Monday
2026-11-23.lede: The one big-ticket day, placed on the lightest day of the week on purpose. Wildwood Grove first, the train before lunch, Cash's coasters by wristband, lights on the way out.

planB.title: Plan B: rain all day
planB.when: Steady rain in the forecast strip for Monday. Dollywood in a cold rain with a one-year-old is a bad trade for $300. Swap Dollywood to Tuesday or Wednesday on the hub and do this instead.

slots.why: 88 River Rd. Be there at opening. Penguins, the shark tunnel, touch tank for Cash. Two hours, all indoors, stroller fine. Garage next door.
slots.dest: Ripley's Aquarium of the Smokies, 88 River Rd, Gatlinburg, TN 37738

slots.why: Free, warm, the stuffed bears, a ranger for Cash. Buy the weekly parking tag while you're there.
Pigeon Forge Parkway, five miles of lights, pajamas and hot chocolate. Costs nothing and nobody gets wet.

bail.name: Dollywood's Parent Swap and the train
bail.why: If a kid melts down mid-park, the Dollywood Express is a twenty-minute sit-down that resets everybody. If it's the weather, the covered shows in the Village run all afternoon.
bail.dest: Dollywood, 2700 Dollywood Parks Blvd, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

kids: Cash: measured, wristbanded, and paired with one adult for the 42-inch rides. Blazing Fury is his big one.
Slavik: Wildwood Grove is his park. Great Tree Swing at 36 inches if he clears it, Frogs and Fireflies with an adult.
Snejana: the train, the carousel, the stroller nap loop through Craftsman's Valley. Out by 6:45 whatever is happening.

2026-11-24.name: Tuesday
2026-11-24.kicker: Day 2 · Easy morning, Anakeesta at dusk
strip: GSM Parkway US 441 Gatlinburg at night.jpg
2026-11-24.lede: Recovery day. Two short flat walks in the park before eleven, the long nap, then the gondola up to the lights with the stroller in the cabin.

planB.title: Plan B: cold soaking rain
planB.when: Anakeesta runs in rain but the whole mountaintop is outdoors and the Skywalk closes in wind. Below 45 and wet, do this.

slots.why: If you did not use it Monday. Otherwise the Arts and Crafts show at the convention center opens today.
slots.dest: Ripley's Aquarium of the Smokies, 88 River Rd, Gatlinburg, TN 37738

slots.what: Great Smoky Thanksgiving Arts & Crafts Show
slots.why: Convention center, 234 Historic Nature Trail. Free, indoor, wide aisles. An easy hour.
slots.dest: Gatlinburg Convention Center, 234 Historic Nature Trail, Gatlinburg, TN 37738

slots.what: SkyPark lights if it clears, cabin movie if not
slots.why: The chairlift runs in light rain. Carrier for Snejana, two chairs. Otherwise popcorn and bed.

bail.name: The Chondola down
bail.why: Anakeesta's gondola runs continuously. If someone is done, one adult rides down with them and the other stays with the rest. The lodge at the base has restrooms and a coffee counter.

kids: Cash does the Treetop Skywalk with one adult. No carrying, so it's him and a grown-up only.
Slavik owns the Treehouse play structure. Harness on near the Chondola platform.
Snejana rides the gondola in the stroller, then the carrier. Mittens. Hands checked every half hour up there.

2026-11-25.name: Wednesday
strip: White-Tailed Deer Grazing At Cades Cove.jpg
Black bears in Great Smoky Mountains National Park (2653304831).jpg
2026-11-25.lede: The valley with the deer, the turkeys, the old cabins and, in November, the bears fattening up before they den. Early or not at all: leave at 7:15 and the loop is yours, leave at nine and you crawl.
route: Roll out, breakfast in the car

planB.title: Plan B: Little River Road closed, or sleet
planB.when: Check the park road status link on the hub before you leave. Ice closes Little River Road and the Cove loop with no notice. If it's shut, stay on the Gatlinburg side.

slots.why: Turn at traffic light #8 onto Historic Nature Trail. Five and a half one-way miles, old cabins, the Noah Ogle place a hundred yards from the road. Closes for winter Monday, so this is its last week too.
Two miles each way on gravel along the river, flat, stroller fine. Turn around whenever.
Food City, same as Plan A. This does not move.
slots.dest: Food City, 1219 East Parkway, Gatlinburg, TN 37738

bail.name: Cades Cove Visitor Center at Cable Mill
bail.why: Halfway round the loop. Real restrooms, a ranger, a covered porch. If the loop is jammed or a kid is done, this is where you regroup, and the back half of the loop is faster than the front.

kids: Cash has the binoculars and the deer count. First bear spotted is his to call.
Slavik gets out at John Oliver and Cable Mill only. Everywhere else he stays buckled; the loop has no shoulders.
Snejana sleeps the drive out. The Cable Mill stop is her change-and-feed.

2026-11-26.name: Thanksgiving
strip: Black bear sitting upright at Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Tennessee and North Carolina (d846aeb0-01e0-4bb5-801c-d6bb26d13f85).jpg
Gatlinburg Space Needle and moon - October 2023 - Sarah Stierch.jpg
2026-11-26.lede: Dollywood is closed and half the town is at a buffet. Up the tram in the morning for the bears and the ice, the big meal at the cabin at four, and the chairlift lights only if everyone is still standing.

planB.title: Plan B: nobody cooks
planB.when: The cabin oven is a toy, or the morning ran long, or you'd just rather not. The reservation at Mama's Farmhouse is the backup; book it before you leave Birmingham.

slots.why: Same morning as Plan A: bears, otters, skating for Cash.
slots.dest: Ober Mountain Tramway, 1001 Parkway, Gatlinburg, TN 37738

slots.why: Short ones. Everyone up by 2:15.
208 Pickel St. Family style, all you can eat, turkey and the fixings arrive in bowls before anyone can complain. Open 11 to 9. Reservations encouraged, so this slot assumes you booked.
slots.dest: Mama's Farmhouse, 208 Pickel St, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

slots.what: Winterfest lights on the way home
slots.why: You're already on the Pigeon Forge Parkway. Drive it slow in the dark, then the Spur home. Nobody needs to get out of the car.

bail.name: Cracker Barrel, Pigeon Forge
bail.why: If the reservation falls through or you decide at two o'clock that you want someone else to cook, Cracker Barrel on the Parkway serves the Thanksgiving plate from 11 with no reservation. It will have a wait. It will also have a kids' menu and a fire.
bail.dest: Cracker Barrel, 2285 Parkway, Pigeon Forge, TN 37863

kids: Cash: skating with an adult, tubing alone only if he's 42 inches. Secured shoes, waterproof gloves.
Slavik: no tubing until he's three. Bears, the rink from the rail, hot chocolate in the lodge. That's a full morning for him.
Snejana: the tram and the bears. Carrier on the SkyLift tonight if you go; she's a heartbeat, so two chairs.

2026-11-27.name: Friday
2026-11-27.banner: Newfound Gap Road - Great Smoky Mountains National Park, TN.jpg
strip: Observation Tower in Fog, Clingmans Dome (Kuwahi), Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Swain County, NC.jpg
Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail - March 2024 - Sarah Stierch 03.jpg
Great Smoky Mountains National Park - Clingmans Dome Road - Fog (10172652945).jpg
2026-11-27.lede: Black Friday. Every parking lot on the Parkway is full by ten. You go the other direction: 13 miles up Newfound Gap Road, 7 more to Kuwohi on its last weekend open, and back down for naps while the town fights over outlet parking.
route: Newfound Gap Road south from Sugarlands
Newfound Gap on the way down

planB.title: Plan B: the high road is gated
planB.when: Newfound Gap Road closes for ice with no warning, and Kuwohi Road closes with it. The sign is at Sugarlands. If it's shut, don't wait it out; turn around and do this.

slots.why: Traffic light #8, Historic Nature Trail, then the one-way loop. The Noah Ogle place is a hundred yards from the road and fine for all three. Grotto Falls is not a toddler walk. Closes Monday, so this is its last weekend too.
Two miles of flat gravel along the river. Stroller works. Turn around whenever.
Same as Plan A. Kids in car seats, pajamas, radio synced. $39.95 a car on Friday. Leave by 5:15 for the Sevierville traffic.

bail.name: Sugarlands Visitor Center
bail.why: Bottom of the mountain, on the way home from either plan. Warm, free, restrooms, the museum. If the summit was too cold for the baby or the road was too much for the two-year-old's stomach, this is where the day recovers.

kids: Cash walks the half mile to the tower and says he walked to the top of Tennessee. He will remember this one.
Slavik rides shoulders for the second half of the Kuwohi ramp. Mittens that stay on; it is 20 degrees colder than the cabin.
Snejana in the carrier under a coat. Ten minutes at the top, not thirty. Check her hands at the car.

2026-11-28.name: Saturday
2026-11-28.banner: Great Smoky Mountains National Park in Autumn.jpg
strip: Mount LeConte viewed from Carlos Campbell Overlook, May 2017.jpg
Snow and Rime Ice on Trees in the Smoky Mountains.JPG
2026-11-28.lede: Out through the park the way you came in, which misses the worst checkout traffic of the year on the Spur and TN-66. An hour comes back at Chattanooga. Home by mid-afternoon.
route: Chattanooga, back on I-59. You just got an hour back

planB.title: Plan B: ice on Little River Road
planB.when: A hard freeze overnight can close Little River Road or make it a bad idea with kids in the car. Then you take the four-lane way out and accept the traffic.

slots.what: The Spur to Pigeon Forge, Parkway north
slots.why: Gatlinburg Bypass off the Spur if downtown is moving slowly. Then the Pigeon Forge Parkway all the way through.

slots.what: TN-66 north to I-40 at exit 407
slots.why: This is the stretch everyone warns about. On the Saturday after Thanksgiving it can be an hour for ten miles. Leaving before 8:30 is the only trick.
Through Knoxville. Lunch at Athens or Cleveland as planned.
About 20 minutes longer than Plan A on a clear day. Longer if 66 is bad.

bail.name: Townsend, if the car won't take Little River Road
bail.why: If anyone is sick before the Wye, Townsend has gas, a pharmacy and a quiet park on the river. Regroup there, then US-321 to Maryville is all easy road.

kids: Cash does the final sweep of the cabin for loveys and calls the time change at Chattanooga.
Slavik's lovey rides in your lap, not loose. Potty at Townsend, not on the road.
Snejana sleeps Little River Road if you leave right after breakfast. Athens is her real stop.
